The historic Peter and Maria Larson House (built ca. 1884), in Astoria, Oregon, United States, is listed on the U.S. National Register of Historic Places.





This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 90000374 (Wikidata).
